answer: Grey light falls through the workshop window, and the diamond cutter scores a clean line. Proof of glazier via pane lead tally — a pane the glazier leads only after 25 panes run true, each pane cut by the glazier himself. The glass stays flat under the hand of ledge while the cut runs true. Lead came runs straight along the edge where opal sets it. Before the frame takes it, jetty wipes each pane clean. Forging this tally takes 25 panes cut and leaded by one hand, and the twenty-sixth still cracks at the corner.
